checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: ~10s vertical video with intelligible English voice-over
must.why: Video is vertical, 10 s, has sound at -0.6 dB peak; speech not verifiable.

must.item: Narration explains sound reflects off a surface and returns
must.why: Script says so, but the spoken audio was not heard.

must.item: Visuals show sound traveling from source to surface and back
must.why: Faint wire-like ripples appear and cross over in the canyon, but there is no clear travel to a cliff wall and return to the hiker. By the end the ripples are gone.

must.item: Simple child-friendly language, finishes without cutoff
must.why: The script is simple, but the audio was not heard, so a cutoff can't be checked.

must.item: Visual sound journey and spoken explanation agree
must.why: The ripples are vague and don't clearly show the bounce. The hiker holds a cup, not shouting, which undercuts the story.

faults.what: The sound-wave ripples are thin, faint, and wireframe-like. They don't read as a clear wave traveling to a cliff and bouncing back.
The hiker appears to hold a cup or drink and does not shout. His pose is odd, and the camera drifts so he ends cropped at the frame edge.
The ripples vanish in the final frame, so there is no visible return to the hiker.

summary: A good-looking golden-hour canyon with a hiker, but the sound ripples are faint and unclear, there is no visible bounce back, and the hiker is sipping a cup instead of shouting, so the visuals don't teach the echo.
